描述_EN: in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. this jar was probably a funerary piece, as lead-glazed vessels could poison the user.
描述_ZN: 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。 这个罐子可能是一件殉葬品，因为铅釉器皿会使使用者中毒。
